Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
When you see this sign you should be warned that:
For 8 km there are road works
For 8 km there are speed humps
For 8 km there is a winding road
You are entering an area prone to birds on the road
Which sign indicates that lanes merge?
Which sign indicates a suburb name?
